title: Hilbert functions of chopped ideals of general plane points
summary: Formalizes Theorem 1.1 and Corollary 5.1 of Hilbert Functions of Chopped Ideals of General Plane Points over arbitrary characteristic-zero fields: the full Hilbert function of degree-d chopped point ideals, the regular-sequence cases, the least stabilization degree, and the Expected Syzygy Conjecture.
